tell: The quarterly revenue range is a floor, not a forecast
evidence: 15/19 prints landed above the top of the range; 0 below the bottom; mean beat vs midpoint 2.54%, median 2.52%
how_to_use: Model next-quarter revenue at guide midpoint x (1 + walk-forward cushion), not the midpoint.

tell: The cushion has halved, and the range has tightened with it
evidence: mean beat vs midpoint 1.86% over the last 8 prints vs 3.04% over the first 11; guide range width fell from 4.9% to 1.9% of the midpoint
how_to_use: Use the trailing-8-print cushion (~1.8%), not the full-history 2.5%; the guide is tighter and less sandbagged than 2021-23.

tell: Bucketed nights guides are the most beatable guide in the pack
how_to_use: Treat a bucketed nights guide as a floor; the 4Q25 print beat a mid-single-digit guide by ~5 points.

tell: Every full-year margin floor has been cleared
evidence: 4Q23: FY2024 floor/point 35.0%, actual 36.4% (met); 1Q24: FY2024 floor/point 35.0%, actual 36.4% (met); 2Q24: FY2024 floor/point 35.0%, actual 36.4% (met); 3Q24: FY2024 floor/point 35.5%, actual 36.4% (beat); 4Q24: FY2025 floor/point 34.5%, actual 35.1% (met); 1Q25: FY2025 floor/point 34.5%, actual 35.1% (met); 2Q25: FY2025 floor/point 34.5%, actual 35.1% (met); 3Q25: FY2025 floor/point 35.0%, actual 35.1% (at_point)
how_to_use: Add the historical cushion to the FY margin floor when setting the base case.

tell: The guides that actually miss are the expense and monetisation lines, not the top line
evidence: 4Q22->1Q23 sm_pct_rev_yoy_bps guided 150.0, actual 190.0; 1Q24->FY2024 sbc_yoy_pct guided 20.0, actual 30.82; 3Q24->FY2024 sbc_yoy_pct guided 25.0, actual 30.82; 3Q24->FY2024 tax_rate_pct guided 20.0, actual 20.5; 2Q25->3Q25 take_rate_yoy_pts guided 0.0, actual -0.69; 4Q25->1Q26 take_rate_yoy_pts guided 0.0, actual -0.1
how_to_use: Haircut the SBC and tax guides; assume the take-rate guide is only directionally right.

tell: ADR direction calls go wrong when FX moves after the guide is set
evidence: 2 of 17 ADR guides wrong: 4Q22 and 1Q23 both guided 'slightly lower ADR' and got +0.2% and +1.4%; all 8 'ADR up' floors were met
how_to_use: Model ADR from the FX basket and regional mix, not from the ADR sentence in the guide.

tell: The full-year guide is only raised, never cut, and the raises come in Q3/Q4
evidence: FY24 margin 35% floor -> 35.5% point at the 3Q24 print; FY25 34.5% floor -> ~35% at 3Q25; FY26 revenue growth 'at least low double digits' (4Q25) -> 'low to mid teens' (1Q26) -> 'at least mid teens' (2Q26)
how_to_use: Assume the FY26 guide is raised again on 5 Nov unless the quarter misses.
